_note: Window thought bubbles. src: own = naman's words (Substack / Instagram / bio), lightly trimmed; voice = written in his voice from that material. when: any | day | night | late. Owner can edit freely.

thoughts.text: observation is only the recollection of the past.
the train of thought has no destination.
if you become separate from the thinking, then who are you?
there's no meaning. you're looking the wrong way.
you are a byproduct of a byproduct.
where is existence? why is existence?
i am aware.
i am aware that i live in a cage built by someone like me.
it is the confinement we're obsessed with, not the freedom.
cover your ears. let the silence pervade.
thinking is an action. there is no action; there just is.
there is no invention. only discovery.
everything is whole. there is nothing to interpret.
i see situations as gradients. two hues, blending.
love isn't a separate colour anymore. it's blended into everything.
everything is in order until you choose to look around.
i am becoming myself and not somebody else.
find peace within absurdism.
all good things in the world are wild and free.
the universe is here. where are you?
invincibility and suffering, the together world.
something is happening to me.
internet shouldn't have been invented.
reassurance in humanity is important.
doodling = therapy.
reality is hyper-connected. most people never stop to notice.
everything coming together, all at once.
the raw, naked nature of reality. emptiness underneath everything.
is the window looking out, or is the sky looking in?
the snake isn't the cage. the loop is.
every room is inside another room's mouth.
andhera isn't the absence of light. it's where you lose the edges.
a kick drum is just a heartbeat someone decided to keep.
i don't make songs. i leave doors open and see what walks in.
rehab was calm. hiraku opened the door. awakened walked through.
the gods didn't die. i just stopped asking them to dance.
paranoia is only attention with nowhere to go.
vision is a lie your eyes agreed on.
the red hand was mine the whole time.
if i dream the characters, who is dreaming me?
the moon doesn't move. we just keep turning to look.
pixels, paint, synths, feet. same thing, different speed.
they rejected me from design school, so i built the school.
a node graph is just a thought with its wiring showing.
every colour is two colours that stopped arguing.
to dance is to agree with gravity for a while.
the plants grow toward the light. i grow toward the noise.
time is a circle. the circle is a spiral, seen from the side.
i was never stuck. i was just looping.
if all information is already out there, what am i missing?
silence is also a frequency.
delhi is loud. the inside is louder.
sab kuch ek saath ho raha hai.
andhera bhi ek rang hai.
ek pinjare mai, aur pinjara bhi main.
who keeps the snake, and who is kept?
one more track before sleep. it's never one.
the sky is just a painting nobody signed.
